proof_body:
by
  intro a b ha hb
  have ha' : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖) := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using ha
  have hb' : Summable (fun n => ‖b n‖) := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb
  exact ⟨summable_norm_sum_mul_range_of_summable_norm ha' hb' |>.of_norm,
    tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_range_of_summable_norm ha' hb'⟩
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ), Summable (fun n => |a n|) → Summable (fun n => |b n|) → Summable (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k * b (n - k)) ∧ (∑' n, a n) * (∑' n, b n) = ∑' n, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k * b (n - k)
